en: Ah, Captain! Thanks for coming.

Eve, what on earth are you
planning to do in the
Summoning Room? You'd
better tell me soon.
Today, I'm thinking of testing\nan advanced application of my\nsummoning arts.

An application...? Like,
something that brings out
super strong warriors? I'm
gonna demand the strongest
hero ever!
Hmm, it's hard to explain\nproperly...

With normal summoning, I call
warriors to this ship as
physical entities to join us,
right?

With this advanced technique, I
trace the memories of warriors
drifting through space and
enter into them.

I think it could be used to find
candidates for new allies or
even for combat mental
training.
That's amazing!
Is it safe?
But it must be expensive,\nright?
Right?! Come on, give me some\nmore praise once in a while!
It's not fair, Eve! I've been\nworking so hard cleaning and\ngetting this room ready...!
Mm-hmm. Coro, you've been\ndoing your best to prepare a\nsurprise for the Captain, too.
Since we're only entering into\nmemories, it'll feel more like\nwe're having a realistic dream.

We aren't actually warping to
distant planets or eras, and we
can return immediately once
the spell is released.

I see... It's like experiencing a
virtual space in the Holodeck.
This sounds interesting,
Captain!
Heh heh heh...
Actually, this application\ntechnique is free! You don't\neven need Gems!
Whaaaaaat?! Are you\nserious~~!?
Coro, Captain, thanks for the\ngreat reactions.
To summon a warrior as a\nphysical entity, the power of\nGems wouldn't be enough.

If we're just temporarily
awakening memories, I can
make it work without Gems if I
try just a little harder.
Well, if I overdo it, I'll get tired,\nso it won't last for very long.
Now then, enough small talk.\nLet's get started.
I can feel a powerful will from a\ncertain warrior right now. I'm\ngoing in.
We've arrived. ...Is this a\nmountain path?
Whoa, it feels so real!
So, is this "Arsensi" person\ninside this memory?

Not a name, just someone. I
won't know who the owner of
these memories is until I'm
inside.
???: ...To think you all were\ninvolved...
???: Albel!
I, I heard something! Was it a\nghost?
It must be the owner of the\nmemories. Let's head toward\nthe voice!
Albel Nox! How dare you do\nthat to my subordinates!
Hm? Oh, these guys? They put\nup a fight, so I just dealt with\nthem briefly.
Though they didn't provide\nmuch of a challenge, hahahaha!
Take this!
Ugh... uuu...
...I-It hurts...
I'll never forgive you...
You...
Why? Because I'm feeling\npretty frustrated. So I'm not\nletting you off easy today.
I might even take on those\nlittle pests watching from the\nback at the same time.
...Huh? What did you say!?
Y-You guys, when did you get\nhere? You don't look like\nAlbel's allies...
Captain, that midriff-baring\nswordsman Albel looks like he's\nitching for a fight with us, too.
Might as well accept the\nchallenge. It's not like we came\nhere to watch a movie.
Even the Uncharted Planet\nProtection Treaty doesn't\napply inside memories, Captain!
Heh, you're gonna help us?\nThanks for that.
Albel is a formidable opponent,\ndespite how he looks. Don't let\nyour guard down.
Are you lot finished talking?\nNot that I care how many more\nof you little pests show up.
Don't you go looking down on\nus!
Just try it. I'll make you regret\nbeing so cocky!
I look forward to it. ...Well, give\nit your best shot.
...Not bad... but... Gwah!!
Damn it... That's impossible!
You still going at it?
...Of course! I won't let people\nlike you...! Guh...!!
Let's go, Cliff.
Huh?

We should get Tynave and the
others to a doctor as soon as
possible. There's no point in
staying here.
...You're right.
But hey, wouldn't it be better\nto just finish this guy off here?
You might be right. But I don't\nhave a hobby of picking on the\nweak.
...Just like him.
Haha, fair enough. Yeah.\nPicking on the weak is no way\nto live.
Um, Captain... was it? Thank\nyou very much. Well, we have\nto get going.
I want to thank you as well.\nThank you.
Thanks for everything. See ya.

They're gone... Looks like
they're heading off to
transport the injured and the
heavy cargo.
Gwaaaaaaaaah!!!
Only Albel remains. Which\nmeans...
The owner of these memories\nis Albel. They were deeply\netched with the recent battle.
It seems those three already\nhad some history with him.
Damn it... those damn insects...
...You lot, you're still here? Are\nyou here to mock me?
No, I suppose it can't be\nhelped. Because I... I lost...
The damn insect... is me...
Hey, why do you think I lost?
Figure it out yourself
You had no allies to rely on
Eat a banana
...Heh. I suppose you're right...
There's no point if you don't\nwin with your own strength... I\nwas a fool to even ask...
What is wrong with this man,\nasking a question only to\ndismiss the answer?
Allies...? Huddling together and\nplaying nice is what those\ndamn insects do...
What? You're saying that\nbelieving in your allies is a form\nof strength...?

Dammit, what could someone
like you, who does nothing but
make subordinates fight,
possibly understand...!
But... I don't think you yourself\nare weak... What do you mean\nby that...?
Huh? A banana? Do you want\nto be cut down!?

Albel, you're a swordsman, but
your build is way too slender.
You need to work on building
some muscle!

And what's with the midriff?
Your hair is too eccentric, too.
You actually have a pretty
decent face, though...

What does appearance matter,
you pest? I don't need lectures
from someone like you, showing
off your navel and chest.
W-well, I'm a girl! This is called\nfashion!
Gideon: Lord Albel! You're safe!
Gideon: Grr... You dare subject\nLord Albel to this?! Curse you!\nPrepare yourself!
...They have nothing to do with\nthis. Get back to the castle,\nnow.
I'll be there shortly. Aquaria will\nbe moving soon...
Gideon: Y-yes, sir! Understood!

Hmph. At least that was
somewhat entertaining. I'll make
sure to remember your faces
as well.
...Albel. He seems like a bit of a\nrogue, but he was truly serious\nabout his pursuit of strength.
He certainly would be a reliable\nally if he joined us.
Hm?
Albel's memories are fading.\n...The spell is reaching its limit.\nLet's head back.
This concludes Albel's story.

We plan to release stories for
various other Characters in the
future. Please look forward to
them.
